prompt:
Create a refined round-2 Minecraft builder reference sheet for WEST CRISSY FIELD / PRESIDIO. Use the attached first image as mood/material reference and second image as the prior concept to improve. Landscape 3:2, plain ivory background, crisp vanilla Minecraft Java 1.21.1 voxel blocks only, skilled human builder quality, no characters or animals. TWO VIEWS SIDE BY SIDE: LEFT straight-on NORTH front orthographic elevation of the entire row 0–9; RIGHT northwest three-quarter view of the entire same row at the SAME SCALE. Fit both complete rows without cropping; generous blank space is fine. Small numbered labels 0–9 and restrained title; small material key below. No extra detail close-ups.
Keep white/cream military architecture, green trim, red and grey roofs, porches, tall warehouse windows, station cupola and US banner flag. Correct the previous concept's three largest faults: rectangular straightened buildings instead of mapped angled footprints; oversized storeys and roofs instead of 0.5 blocks/metre; generic small buildings rather than distinct historic silhouettes. A storey is about TWO BLOCKS, two-storey walls about 4–5 blocks. Show actual countable blocks, not miniature bricks or thin non-Minecraft modeling. Recess glass panes, frame windows, project porch posts and awnings, use stairs/slabs for roof eaves/verges/ridges. Roof ridges follow each building's long axis, including diagonal step alignment. Tidy low historic military post near bay; no bridge or water outside plots.
SITE GEOMETRY IS PRIORITY. North = low z, east = high x. Each module sits y=0 on its own flat ONE BLOCK smooth_stone plot. No rotation to face viewer. No walls outside # footprints; dots are open lawn/paving. Each map character means 2x2 blocks, clipped at plot dimensions. Clean regular block steps for angled walls. Both rows will be small and wide within each column; this is intentional. Do not stack the two views. Keep material key along bottom. The top/eaves must expose these stepped footprints in the right view. Strict small scale: each two-storey house has only 4 blocks of wall height, warehouse roof peak <=10 blocks above base. Do not reproduce the over-detailed tall walls in the previous render. Each voxel is large and countable. Preserve the exact ten subjects, colors, signs, cupola, flag, porch, doors and lighting. Save a single landscape 3:2 reference sheet.
